p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, start-up, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official sources, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for one product, one country, customs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (MAP): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and Duties on Entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check if a platform is not regulated before entrusting money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: The page is opened in its language: use your browser's translator, or "Understand Document" for a document. For a critical decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file a customs declaration: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Commitments and Rules for Almost Every Country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: Taric: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Bill of Lading (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EUI number (businesses importing or exporting to the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: The buyer takes care of everything from the seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the carrier of the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; thereafter, risk and cost are on the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers at destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. such lists are rejected and can be reported.
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money alone and does not earn anything from these links: you compare them here, and then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Worldwide money transfer rates (World Bank): the real cost of sending money, by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market rate, fees are displayed before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallets, bank transfers, cash withdrawals.
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total income: fees + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN...).
p.espaces.mt_k3: A personal identification document is often required, both for dispatch and for collection.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you only met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, credit or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the right price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer. It's easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is permitted in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without approval.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (wholesale websites or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Find the right price: for the product, delivery, customs duties, VAT in the buyer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the exact delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trade rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.

p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich fast.
